paper_title: First results of axion dark matter search with DANCE
notes: First results from DANCE Act-1 prototype. The paper reports a 95% CL upper limit of g_agamma ≲ 8×10^-4 GeV^-1 in the mass range 10^-14 eV < m_a < 10^-13 eV from a 24-hour observation. This is encoded as a horizontal line (mass-independent bound over the stated validity range). The experiment uses a bow-tie ring cavity to detect rotational oscillation of linearly polarized light caused by axion-photon coupling, without external magnetic field. The DM density assumed is ρ_a = 0.4 GeV/cm^3 (local galactic DM density near the Sun, as stated in Eq. 8). Although the bound does not exceed current best limits (CAST, SHAFT, ABRACADABRA-10cm), this is the first demonstration of polarization-based axion DM search without external magnetic field.
